hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: As I scurry through the dimly lit halls of the inn, the flickering candlelight casts shadows that dance on the stone walls. I hear a soft splash and the sound of water rushing, and I find myself in the laundry room. The air is thick with the scent of soapy water and the fragrance of lavender. I’m washing clothes in a wooden tub, the linen soaks up the warmth of the hearth. As I lather up the last piece of cloth, goosebumps rise on my arms, and my pulse races. The footsteps of a gentleman approaching the room create an electric tension. What will he find when he opens the door?
caption:
Caught in the quiet of the laundry room...
